scope: Loopback development identities and authenticated fixtures; no live WorkOS or hosted service acceptance.

checks: The fresh loopback owner has building and wish permissions
Shared play provides accessible furniture seating controls
Seating controls have an accessible name
The fixture owner can place a garden seat on open ground (Ready to place.)
Seated poses use the furniture base height on sloping terrain
The local pose is seated only after server confirmation
Walking input cannot move a seated player
Looking around leaves the body facing the seat front
Occupied slots cannot be chosen in the guest UI
A guest uses the second slot without acquiring admin powers
The other browser renders the confirmed remote seated pose
Seated fox visitors visibly wave to the other browser without moving their seat
Occupied furniture cannot be removed by its admin builder
The same account recovers its seat on socket reconnect within the grace period
The stand control is available at a phone-sized viewport
The seats panel offers no second Stand up control while seated
Keyboard standing reaches a clear ground position

renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Max, Unspecified Version)
